name: My 3-in-1 Girlfriend
source:
You, the protagonist, have always dreamed of being a mangaka ever since you were little. And now, as a second-year high school student, you’ve finally made that dream a reality!

But as you've come to realize, balancing school life with the demanding work of a professional mangaka is no easy feat. With deadlines piling up and exhaustion slowly taking its toll, you find yourself on the verge of giving up.

That is, until you meet her.

As your assistant, Mitsuha Rena came by to your studio every day to help you work on your manga, easing your burden. With each passing day, the two of you grow closer, finding comfort and companionship in your shared passion.

However, this assistant of yours came with her own set of challenge. Turns out, Rena has not one, not two, but THREE distinct personalities!

Mirena, Tsurena, and Harena. These 3 sides of Rena all have their own distinct quirks, preferences, and struggles. While they all share the same body, getting along with each and every one of them is no easy task!

Will you be able to love every side of her?

[From [url=https://lasthopestudio.itch.io/my-3-in-1-girlfriend]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
身为男主角的你从小就梦想成为一名漫画家。如今，升入高二的你终于将这个梦想变成了现实！

然而你很快意识到，要在兼顾学业的同时应付职业漫画家繁重的工作绝非易事。眼看截稿日接踵而至，身心俱疲的你已濒临放弃的边缘。

直到你遇见了她。

作为你的漫画助手，三叶玲奈每天都会来到你的工作室帮忙赶稿，为你分担重任。日复一日的相处让你们愈发亲近，在共同的热爱中找到了慰藉与陪伴。

不过，你这位得力助手自身也有着棘手的难题——原来，玲奈体内拥有的不是一个、也不是两个，而是整整三个截然不同的人格！

美玲奈、津玲奈与晴玲奈。玲奈的这三个侧面各自有着独特的怪癖、喜好与烦恼。尽管她们共用同一具身体，想要与每一个她都融洽相处却绝非易事！

你能否爱上她的每一面呢？

[摘自[url=https://lasthopestudio.itch.io/my-3-in-1-girlfriend]Itch.io[/url]]
